sentences.en: My recommendation is that you invest in government bonds.
sentences.zh: 我建议你投资政府债券。

sentences.en: The recommendation from my boss made all the difference.
sentences.zh: 老板的建议起了决定性的作用。

sentences.en: I've added my recommendations to improve the situation.
sentences.zh: 我已经提出了改进建议来改善现状。

senses.zh: 推荐, 劝告, 建议(尤做法) - 推荐信, 介绍信 形容词: recommendatory
